name: PMEGP
description: Naya business start karne pe 15-35% tak subsidy milti hai. Manufacturing aur dono ke liye hai.
education: 8th pass (self-help group ke liye minimum qualification nahi)
benefit: 25% tak subsidy milta hai project cost pe (SC/ST/women ke liye 35%)
how_to_apply: KVIC ki website pe online apply karo ya nearest Khadi office me jao

name: Mudra Loan
description: Chhote business ke liye collateral-free loan (bina guarantee ke). 3 categories hain - Shishu, Kishor, Tarun.
education: Not specified - business plan hona chahiye
benefit: Collateral-free loan (bina kisi guarantee ke). Interest rates 10-12%.
how_to_apply: Kisi bhi bank, NBFC, ya microfinance institution me apply karo

name: CGTMSE
full_name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises
description: Collateral-free credit facility - bank loan lene ke liye koi guarantee nahi chahiye. Existing businesses ke liye best hai.
benefit: Upto Rs 5 crore tak collateral-free loan. Government guarantee deti hai bank ko.
how_to_apply: Kisi bhi scheduled bank me jao aur CGTMSE scheme ke liye apply karo
eligibility_note: Business minimum 1 year purana hona chahiye, profit me hona chahiye

name: Stand-Up India
description: SC, ST aur Women ke liye bank loan. Rs 10 lakh se 1 crore tak. Greenfield projects ke liye.
benefit: Rs 10 lakh se 1 crore tak loan. 75% project cost tak loan mil sakta hai.
how_to_apply: standupmitra.in pe register karo ya nearest bank branch me jao

name: Udyogini Yojana
description: Women entrepreneurs ke liye special scheme. Business start karne ke liye loan aur subsidy.
benefit: 30% tak subsidy + loan facility. Special focus on rural women.
how_to_apply: Women & Child Development office me jao ya online apply karo

name: MSME Champions Scheme
description: Technology upgradation ke liye subsidy. Old machines nayi se replace karne pe 25% tak subsidy.
benefit: Technology upgrade pe 25% capital subsidy. MSME registration zaroori hai.
how_to_apply: MSME Champions portal pe apply karo

name: ZED Certification
description: Quality certification jo international standards ka hai. Certification cost pe 80% tak subsidy milti hai.
benefit: Certification cost pe 80% subsidy + market access badhta hai + government orders milte hain
how_to_apply: ZED portal pe register karo aur nearby ZED certification agency se contact karo

name: MSME Samadhaan
description: Agar koi bada company tumhe payment nahi de rahi (45 din se zyada), toh is portal pe complaint karo.
benefit: Delayed payment pe 15% interest mil sakta hai. Legal support bhi milta hai.
how_to_apply: MSME Samadhaan portal pe complaint file karo with invoice details

name: MSME Samaadhan
description: International standards ke liye compliance support. ISO certification aur quality management me help.
benefit: ISO certification cost pe reimbursement. Quality improvement ke liye support.
how_to_apply: MSME ministry ke nearest office me contact karo

name: DIC Registration
description: Har district me ek DIC hota hai jo MSME ko register karta hai aur subsidies provide karta hai. State-specific schemes ke liye pehla step.
benefit: State subsidies ke liye eligible bante ho. Registration certificate milta hai jo bahut kaam aata hai.
how_to_apply: Apne district ka DIC office me jao. Google me '[tumhara district] DIC office' search karo.

name: PMEGP
description: Self-employment ke liye loan + training. Naya business start karna ho toh ye scheme dekho.
benefit: Rs 2 lakh tak loan + free skill training. Subsidy bhi milti hai.
how_to_apply: MSME ministry ki website pe ya nearest DIC office me apply karo

name: CLCSS
description: Technology upgradation ke liye 15% capital subsidy. Old machinery upgrade karne ke liye.
benefit: 15% capital subsidy (max Rs 15 lakh) technology upgrade pe. MSME registration zaroori hai.
how_to_apply: Listed lending agencies ke through apply karo
